select * from ( select rownum rn, t.* from ( SELECT o.outbound_id, d.outbound_detail_id, p.product_name, d.quantity, a.approval_status, nvl(l.is_expired, 'N') as is_expired, nvl(w.warehouse_name, '미배정') as warehouse_name,
req.webuser_name AS requester_name, app.webuser_name AS approver_name, conf.webuser_name AS confirmer_name,
o.request_date AS requested_date, a.created_at AS approved_date, l.shipped_date, d.reason, i.is_refund
FROM outbound_detail d LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.outbound_id = d.outbound_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = d.product_id
LEFT JOIN webuser req ON req.webuser_id = o.webuser_id
LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.outbound_id = o.outbound_id LEFT JOIN webuser app ON app.webuser_id = a.approver_id
LEFT JOIN lot_out l ON l.outbound_detail_id = d.outbound_detail_id LEFT JOIN webuser conf ON conf.webuser_id = l.confirmer_id left join inbound i on i.lot_out_id=l.lot_out_id
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id order by o.outbound_id desc, d.outbound_detail_id desc )t where product_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or requester_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or approver_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or confirmer_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or outbound_detail_id like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' ) where rn >= #{startRow} and rn <= #{endRow}
